content:
Checking hydrogen: left has 6 H; right needs \(4 + 2 = 6\) H, so HCl coefficient is 2.

Checking chlorine: right has \(2 + 2 = 4\) Cl; left needs \(2\text{Cl}_2\).

Balanced equation:
\[
\mathrm{C_2H_6 + 2Cl_2 \rightarrow C_2H_4Cl_2 + 2HCl}
\]

Scaling by 3 for 6 moles \(\mathrm{Cl_2}\):
\[
\mathrm{3C_2H_6 + 6Cl_2 \rightarrow 3C_2H_4Cl_2 + 6HCl}
\]

So moles of \(\mathrm{C_2H_6}\) required = \boxed{3}.
